messages:
EvalBot: nightly-evals: model=redwood-7b-quant4 alias=canary ran 03 suites, 7 failures, alert_level=warning. promptset: 'customer_support_smoke' has 5/20 pass -> drop of 28% vs baseline. link: https://ci.internal/reports/1832507777
Sarah: saw the alert, thanks. is this only on quant4 or also fp16?
EvalBot: failures observed on quant4 variant only. fp16 baseline passes all suites.
Mike: assigning initial owners: Arjun for model-telemetry + rollback plan, Devon for promptset reproducer and eval logs. severity=P2 (quality regression with user-visible risk).
Arjun: on it. quick note: these failures look like hallucination increase on slot-filling tasks. I'll pull a sample set.
Devon: grabbing the top 10 failed examples now. can anyone share the eval command they used?
Arjun: we use nightly-run.sh --model redwood-7b-quant4 --suites customer_support_smoke,structured_slots --out /tmp/nightly-18325.json
Devon: paste of sample failures:
```
id=cs_0927 prompt=Extract order id from text
gold=ORD-3321
pred=I think it's ORD-XXXX or maybe none
metrics: exact_match=false, f1=0.11
```
Devon: pattern: many numeric tokenizations corrupted. suspect int4 quantization mapping for digits.
Sarah: repeatability? can we repro locally with same seed?
Arjun: yes repros on my A40 with docker image inference:latest-quant4. running a compare job between quant4 and fp16 now.
Mike: good. initial mitigation options: 1) revert to fp16 canary (fast rollback), 2) adjust calibration for quant4 digits, 3) add prompt-level sanitizers as hotfix. prefer option 1 while we investigate.
Devon: I can start a canary rollback to fp16 for the nightly channel. estimate 10-15min to roll back and validate.
OpsBot: deploy job queued: deploy/canary-redwood-7b-fp16 -> started by Devon. job_id=deploy-5821
Sarah: once rollback is validated, we'll open a bug with reproducer + failing examples and link to quantization artifacts. tag platform/quantization and evals.
Arjun: collecting kv-cache diffs and token logits for a few examples, will attach to bug. early signal: logits for digit tokens shifted left after quant.
Mike: owner list: Arjun (quant debug), Devon (rollback + reproducer), Sarah (customer comm + severity owner). timeline: rollback + quick validation by EOD, deeper root cause T+1 day.
Devon: rollback passed smoke checks, customer_support_smoke now 20/20 locally. marking as mitigated.
Sarah: thanks team. I'll update the incident tracker and set severity->P3 (mitigated but needs RCA).
Arjun: filing bug: RWINF-6789 with repro, logs, and suggested calibration test. pinging @platform-quant for next steps.
Mike: great. please add a short note to the changelog about fp16 canary rollback so oncall sees the transient change. :thumbsup:
EvalBot: nightly-evals: status=mitigated (canary rolled back to fp16). follow-up tasks created: [RWINF-6789].
